## What happened?

- I'm behind on US taxes→
- My bank or broker asked for US tax details→
- I have foreign investments→
- I own part of a foreign company→
- I inherited money or received a large gift from abroad→
- I'm self-employed abroad→
- I sold, or am selling, my home abroad→
- I'm considering giving up US citizenship→

Several at once or not sure? Combine them on the start page. Tax professional? See a sample case and workpaper.

## The map can identify when a portfolio scan matters.

A UCITS ETF, a Swiss fund unit, or funds inside an ISA or PEA can bring extra U.S. reporting. Start with the situation check; if a holding needs a closer look, the portfolio scan checks each ticker or ISIN and shows its source and assumptions.

Try it

Check a ticker or ISIN in seconds.

Example portfolio result Illustration

3 likely PFICs across 4 positions

- IWDA Ireland · UCITS ETF Likely PFIC (high)
- VWRL Ireland · UCITS ETF Likely PFIC (high)
- CH0032912732 Switzerland · fund unit Likely PFIC (medium)
- VTI United States · ETF Not a PFIC (high)

Forms this triggers

- Form 8621 × 3 computed

One per likely PFIC held during the year.
- FinCEN 114 (FBAR) needs input

Depends on the highest balance across all foreign accounts.
- Form 8938 (FATCA) needs input

Depends on your filing status and where you live.

Assumptions shown

- Vehicle matched by ISIN, not by ticker alone
- Foreign legal domicile taken from the fund record
- No election assumed on any holding

Still to confirm

- The issuer's annual PFIC facts
- Whether QEF information is available
- Any prior-year election history

An illustration built from sample tickers, not a customer portfolio and not a legal determination. Your own scan reads your holdings and shows its reasoning the same way — how the screening works.

## Start from your situation. See what may apply. Choose the next step.

The example result in the hero is what step two produces.

The sample report is what step three delivers.

1. 01

### Start from your situation

Pick what happened — never filed, a bank letter, foreign funds, a company abroad — and answer only the questions that situation needs. Holdings can be imported from a brokerage CSV.
2. 02

### See what may apply

Every filing area marked likely, possible or needs review, with the fact that would settle it, the complexity of the year and what puts a clock on it.
3. 03

### Choose the next step

One recommended route, priced from the catalogue: a written assessment, a self-serve package, an accountant handoff, or a scoped catch-up quote.

## Let your answers point to the right path.

The free assessment maps likely filing areas, open questions and complexity. Then it recommends one next step, with the scope and price shown before you pay.

### How the work is divided, before you pay.

- Software prepares

The engine reads your entries, computes the figures for the year, maps each one to an IRS form line and lists the assumption behind it. The on-screen result comes before any payment.

How the figures are worked
- Generated from your entries

Packages are generated automatically from your confirmed entries.

The exact scope of the check
- You review, sign and file

Every form is signed by you and filed by you — the return with the instructions in the package, the FBAR on FinCEN's site. The package is complete when you have done both.

The whole path, step by step
- Judgment stays with a professional

Whether conduct was non-willful (your certification on Form 14653), a treaty position, an expatriation decision, an open examination — these are calls for a professional you engage, with the Atamatax package as their starting point.

Where your data lives

## Know what you are getting before you pay.

Explore a sample report and compare the package that matches your situation. The sample is the engine's real output on a worked example: computed figures mapped to IRS forms and lines, the assumptions behind each one, and the fields left for you or your accountant.

## Built and maintained by its founder, in Switzerland.

Founder of Atamatax. A software developer based in Monthey, Switzerland, who built a PFIC-first US expat tax tool after working through the Form 8621 problem the existing software skips. Writes the guides on this site; technical determinations are gated on independent professional review.

Danilson Ramos · Founder, Atamatax · Monthey, Switzerland

## Wherever you live, the local products are the hard part.

## Questions before you start.

What does the free situation check tell me?

Which US filing areas your answers point at — the return, the FBAR, Form 8938, Form 8621, an entity or trust return — each marked likely, possible or needs review with the fact that would settle it; how complex the year looks; what puts a clock on it; and one recommended next step. It indicates; it never determines.

I have never filed. Where do I start?

Start with the free catch-up check. It reads your years and facts against the published Streamlined factors and names the likely tier. A Streamlined engagement covers up to 3 delinquent federal returns and up to 6 FBAR years, priced $1,590–$2,990+ · scoped quote after free case scoping. You certify non-willfulness on Form 14653, sign, and file.

Does a ticker alone prove that a fund is a PFIC?

No. Atamatax uses ticker and ISIN matches as screening inputs, then shows the vehicle, domicile, source facts and assumptions that still need confirmation. The statutory income and asset tests and the fund's legal structure control.

Can I import my portfolio today?

Yes. Brokerage positions CSV import and manual ticker or ISIN entry are the available portfolio-entry methods presented in this flow today.

What do I get before paying?

The free portfolio scan shows likely PFIC exposure, potential FBAR and FATCA threshold questions, assumptions, open items and a recommended next step. No credit card is required for that result.

What is the difference between CPA Export and PFIC Portfolio?

CPA Export ($199) is a worksheet and analysis handoff for an accountant. PFIC Portfolio ($499) is the supported annual filing-package path with up to 25 supported Forms 8621.
